SINGAPORE -> BANGALORE AIR CARGO, India 85423100 8807448'. The declared HS 854231 matches the company's imported components (microprocessors/ICs from Texas Instruments, Avnet), i.e. it describes what the company BUYS, not what it demonstrably sells. Export status is marked confirmed only on the strength of the buyer-side counterparty rows (TD Computech, BAE Systems, Okano, 7th Sense, Consat) which indicate outbound flows, but no dated export B/L with destination and HS could be read in the free view — so export volumes, values and dates remain unverified. Role reads as manufacturer_trader (embedded-systems design plus component trading). No revenue or export value figures are public in the sources reachable — left null, not estimated. Domestic supply: no traces found in accessible sources, but this is a retrieval failure (403s), not evidence of absence.
